This app was developed by former smokers based on the experiences of many other former smokers and has already helped millions of users quit smoking. How can it help you?

In the beginning there is your decision. Let's not fool ourselves. If you are not serious, it will be difficult. But if you really want it, your chances are good that you will make it with the help of this app.

There are many different strategies, methods, and tools that can help you quit. Whether one thing or the other works better for you can vary from person to person, but the experiences of millions of former smokers show that it is almost always a mixture of information, motivation and participation that ultimately led to success.

Therefore, this app relies on a selection of tried and tested methods and tools, which are based on the three strategic pillars of information, motivation and participation.


What tools does this app offer?

Numbers::
Keep track of the most important numbers: number of days as a non-smoker, number of cigarettes not smoked, money saved.

Health:
Review your health progress and your physical reactions to not smoking.

Knowledge:
Carefully researched and comprehensive knowledge, context and advice on every aspect of smoking will ensure that your decision to quit is strengthened, that you remain motivated and are as well prepared as possible for withdrawal.

Tasks:
During the particularly difficult initial period of quitting, you will be given small tasks every day, aimed at reflecting on the knowledge you have learned, convincing you of your decision, and keeping motivation high.

Cravings Help:
If you want to have a cigarette, you will be shown practical solutions for the respective situations in which you are currently in. Statistics also show you in which situations you are most often at risk, so that you can avoid them or approach them differently in the future.

Top 10 Tips:
Get valuable advice from former smokers about what helped them the most to quit smoking. Since they speak from experience, there's a good chance that there's something there that will be a great help to you too.

Awards:
You regularly receive awards for milestones achieved on your way to becoming a non-smoker, which you can share with family and friends.

Savings goals:
Set savings goals and watch getting closer and closer to them because of the money you save.

100 reasons:
If you have a strong cigarette craving, 100 reasons to not smoke a cigarette will help you.

Apple Watch App:
The Apple Watch app quickly shows you the most important numbers of your non-smoking career.

Widget:
The widget quickly shows you the most important numbers of your non-smoking career.

results.description:
Cold turkey works for almost no one. Stepdown gets you off nicotine by stepping down; small, scheduled reductions your body barely notices, until one day the number is zero.

Works for vapes, nicotine pouches, cigarettes, nicotine gum, lozenges, heated tobacco and snus.

Answer a few questions and see, free: your Nic Score (how tight a grip nicotine actually has on your day), your personal staircase, and your projected quit date.

YOUR STAIRCASE
- A plan of small steps; each one holds your daily limit slightly lower while your body adjusts
- One-tap logging for every pouch, puff, pod or cigarette
- An AI coach that knows your exact plan and answers at 2am
- A panic button for cravings; most pass in about three minutes
- Danger-window alerts that fire before your risky hours, not after
- Step briefings, daily debriefs, and body-recovery milestones
- A savings jar showing the money you keep instead of burn

WHY STEPPING DOWN WORKS
Quitting all at once means peak withdrawal, peak irritability, and peak chance of a bad day that convinces you that you can't do it. Stepping down spreads that cost across weeks, so no single day has to be the day you quit quitting.

WENT OVER? KEEP GOING
Go over your limit and nothing resets. The staircase adjusts astreak to break and no starting over.

FREE
Your Nic Score, staircase preview, and quit date.

A subscription is required for the full plan, coach, and tracking. Subscriptions auto-renew until cancelled; manage or cancel anytime in your Apple
Account settings.

Stepdown is a habit app, not a medical service. It does not prnosis, or treatment. If you have a medical concern, talk to ahealthcare provider.

Have you considered quitting smoking? Whether you’ve already quit smoking or you’re still thinking about it, QuitNow will help you quit tobacco for good.

Quitting smoking is one of the best decisions you can make for your health: it reduces your risk of disease, you regain energy, you save money, and you also protect the people around you. But the truth is, quitting isn’t easy.

That’s where QuitNow comes in.

QuitNow was born in 2011, created by a smoker who wanted to quit. Since then, we’ve grown, brought in addiction specialists, and refined our tools so you can quit tobacco for good:

YOUR EX-SMOKER STATUS
When you quit smoking, it’s important to clearly see what you’re achieving. That’s why on QuitNow’s home screen you’ll see how long it’s been since you last smoked, how many cigarettes you haven’t smoked, how much money you’ve saved, and how much life you’ve regained.

COMMUNITY: THE EX-SMOKERS’ CHAT
Having a smoke-free environment is crucial when you quit. QuitNow offers a chat full of people who, like you, have said goodbye to tobacco. Sharing your journey with other ex-smokers will make your path easier.

LIVE SESSIONS WITH AN EXPERT
Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.

A COMPLETE COURSE TO QUIT SMOKING
Some people prefer a more structured method when they quit. That’s why QuitNow includes a step-by-step course designed to guide you throughout the entire quitting process. It works like a digital book, but integrated inside the app.

MILESTONES: SMALL MOTIVATIONS TO QUIT SMOKING
As with any task in life, quitting is easier when you break the challenge into smaller goals. That’s why QuitNow offers 80 milestones based on the cigarettes you’ve avoided, the days you’ve gone without smoking, and the money you’ve saved. This way, you can start celebrating your wins from day one.

YOUR HEALTH AS AN EX-SMOKER
In QuitNow you’ll find a list of health indicators that show how your body improves day by day. These indicators are the same ones published by the World Health Organization, and we update them as soon as the WHO does.

Plus, QuitNow includes other sections designed to help you on your journey to quit smoking.

QUITNOW AI
Whenever questions come up during your quitting process, you can turn to QuitNow AI. It’s designed to provide clear, reliable information, based on our course and on data from the World Health Organization.

BOOKS TO HELP YOU QUIT SMOKING
Learning techniques and approaches to quit can make the process much easier. That’s why we’ve selected well-known books that can effectively help you on your path to a tobacco-free life.

ALSO ON YOUR WATCH
QuitNow’s Apple Watch app and its widgets and tiles let you track your progress, see how much you’ve saved, and check your smoke-free stats right from your wrist.

Because we dedicate so much time and effort to it, we firmly believe QuitNow is the best app to quit smoking. As always, there’s room for improvement—so if you have any idea to make QuitNow even better, please write to us at ios@quitnow.app.

We truly hope QuitNow supports you on your journey to a tobacco-free life.

I Am Sober is more than just a free sobriety counter app.

Along with tracking your sober days, it helps you build new habits and provides ongoing motivation by connecting you to a wide network of people all striving for the same goal: staying sober one day at a time.

Through our growing sober community you can learn from others and contribute by sharing insights and tactics that have worked for you.

**The I Am Sober app features:**

• Sober day tracker
To visualize how long you’ve been sober.

• Remember why you quit
Add reasons and photos to help you remember why you want to quit your addiction and stay sober.

• Daily pledge tracker
Take a pledge every day. Sobriety is a 24-hour struggle, so start your day off by making a pledge to stay sober. Then you can review how your day went and log notes at the end of the day.

• Sobriety calculator
View how much money & time you’ve saved by being sober.

• Analyze triggers
Recap each day and find patterns that made your day easier or more challenging than the last.

• Share your story
Either with others or for yourself, take photos and journal your progress directly in the app. Then choose to share it or save it as a reminder for yourself.

• Milestone tracker
Track and celebrate your milestones from 1 day, to 1 week, to 1 month and beyond. Compare experiences with others on their sober journey. Read how they felt at this milestone and what you can expect. If you’re struggling, share your story and invite others to offer help or advice.

• Withdrawal timeline
When you create an account and declare your addiction, you can instantly see a withdrawal timeline to get an idea of what to expect for your next few days (and weeks). What’s more, you can contribute to it. See how many others saw an increase in their restfulness vs those that saw an increase in anxiety. Prepare yourself for what’s to come in recovery.

• Customize your experience
You set the time, your sober birthday, the category of motivation you need, the addictions you’re trying to break, even the end-of-day summaries. Make the app customized to your lifestyle and tailored to your needs.

**Sober Plus subscriptions**

I Am Sober is free to use, but you can support development of the app with a subscription to Sober Plus. With Sober Plus, you'll get access to these premium features:

• Create a group
Stay accountable together and track your sobriety privately. Groups are great for complimenting your real-world group like Alcoholics Anonymous, NA, SA, SMART Recovery, or your rehab center.

• Locked access
Keep your trackers private with a lock that you can access via TouchID or FaceID.

• Data Backups
Save your progress in the cloud and restore your trackers if you get a new device.

• More tracking
Track more addictions and get access to more communities. Even if your addiction is specific like Wine, Online Shopping, or Skin Picking, you’ll find a variety of communities of people who are all trying to get sober from alcohol, drugs, eating disorders, self-harm, and more.

QuitSure is built on the science of why you smoke - and uses that science to undo the addiction at its root.

The QuitSure program takes about one hour per day over 6 days - roughly 8 to 10 hours total. Each day, you'll read, watch, and listen to content designed to change how your mind thinks about smoking.

Quitting smoking transforms every part of your life - and it starts sooner than you think.

Quit Cigarette Smoking with QuitBot – Scientifically Designed to Help You Stop Smoking for Good

Quitting smoking is one of the most important decisions you can make for your health, and QuitBot is here to help every step of the way. Developed by scientists at the Fred Hutchinson Cancer Center, QuitBot is an evidence-based, chatbot-powered quit smoking app designed to support you on your journey to becoming smoke-free!

Free app & no login code required. Just download the app and get started immediately!

Why Choose QuitBot?

Unlike other stop smoking apps, QuitBot is the only app supported by scientific research to provide you with an interactive virtual coach that offers personalized guidance, motivation, and practical tools to help you quit smoking for good. Chat with your virtual coach. Ask the coach your questions about quitting smoking. QuitBot helps you stay focused and committed to your goals.

Check out the research: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/38913882/

Trevor Noah was fascinated by QuitBot and interviewed the scientist who developed it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=6bTQfWsWC7g

QuitBot Features:

Step-by-Step Quit Plan QuitBot guides you through the quitting process with a structured plan tailored to your needs. From setting a quit date to managing cravings, we’ve got you covered.

Ask your questions. The virtual coach has been programmed to accurately answer thousands of questions about quitting cigarette smoking.

Tools to Manage Cravings Gain access to a variety of tools to help you handle the urge to smoke. Learn techniques to handle triggers that are based on an novel approach to behavior change.

Daily Motivation & Insights Stay inspired with daily motivational messages and expert-backed insights to keep you focused on your smoke-free journey.

Stay on Track Monitor your progress with a personalized dashboard that tracks your smoke-free days, the number of cigarettes you’ve avoided, and the health benefits of stopping smoking.

Set and Achieve Milestones Celebrate every achievement, from your first smoke-free day to reaching major milestones like one week, one month, and beyond. Each milestone marks another victory on your path to a healthier life.

Journal Your Journey Log your thoughts, emotions, and experiences throughout your quitting journey. Keeping a record helps you reflect on your progress and identify patterns that can help you stay smoke-free.

Identify and Manage Triggers QuitBot helps you analyze what situations, emotions, or environments trigger your urge to smoke. Learn how to  cope with these triggers effectively.

Understand Withdrawal Symptoms Get insights into what to expect as your body adjusts to stopping smoking. Learn about common withdrawal symptoms and how to manage them successfully.

Personalized Experience Customize your QuitBot journey by setting your own quit smoking date, receiving tailored advice, and tracking progress in a way that fits your lifestyle.

Start Your Smoke-Free Journey Today!

If you're ready to stop smoking, QuitBot is here to help. Download the QuitBot quit smoking app now and take the first step toward a healthier, smoke-free life!

Quit smoking at your own pace. Alive helps you make it happen.

Tired of cigarettes controlling your life? Alive helps you take back control without the pressure of quitting cold turkey. With a personalized plan and a simple smoking tracker, you can gradually quit smoking, ease withdrawals, and reduce anxiety without pressure.

Unlike other apps, Alive doesn’t expect you to be smoke-free on day one. Whether you’re considering quitting, struggling with it, or adjusting to life without cigarettes, Alive supports you every step of the way.

You’re in charge. Track your progress, take it slow, pause anytime, and come back when you’re ready. No pressure, no guilt. And when you’re ready to stop smoking for good, Alive supports you with tracking tools, guidance, and gentle reminders—especially when things get tough.

Ready to break free? Alive has your back—every step of the way. Download now and begin your journey to a smoke-free life today!

Why Choose Alive to Quit Smoking?

Alive isn’t just about breaking free from cigarettes—it’s about celebrating every win along the way. The app helps your body gradually adapt to less nicotine, easing dependence and minimizing withdrawal, making your smoke-free journey smoother.

Here’s How Alive Helps:

• Track Stats & Milestones: See detailed statistics on how far you've come in real time, from cigarettes avoided to money saved. Track exactly how much you’re gaining by cutting back.

• Track Cigarette Reduction: Record your smoking patterns, progress, and reduction using our cigarette log and smoking tracker as you gradually work to stop smoking.

• Save Money: Cutting back helps your health and wallet. Track the money you’re saving with every cigarette you choose to skip.

• Monitor Withdrawals: Receive support through encouraging notifications and smart reminders, along with practical tips to manage anxiety and stay strong through cravings as you cut back.

How Does Alive Work?

1. Start by entering your smoking habits.

2. Log each cigarette with the smoking tracker. Sometimes, the waiting timer will gently ask you to pause a few minutes, helping you delay urges and build discipline.

3. Follow your personalized plan in weekly phases, gradually increasing time between cigarettes to help your body adapt to less nicotine while tracking withdrawals.

4. Track your progress & milestones. At the end of each week, you can choose to advance or stay in the current phase, giving you control to quit at your own pace.

Additionally, our Quit Smoking Savings Calculator helps you track how much money you save as you gradually reduce smoking, so you feel good in your body and your bank account.

Support After Quitting

Quitting is just the beginning. Alive stays with you every step of the way. Use the smoking tracker and cigarette log to reflect on how far you’ve come. Dive into our app for quit smoking tips, daily encouragement, and practical motivation to help you stay strong, stay smoke-free, and live the life you deserve.

Download Alive now and start your journey to quit smoking today.

Subscription & Pricing Policy

Alive is free for the first week. Choose a subscription plan that fits your budget—it’s an investment in your health with big rewards.

Consult your doctor—this app is a helpful tool, not a medical treatment. Ultimately, the final step is yours: that last cigarette and your commitment. Remember: one step is always easier than a giant leap.

results.description:
The moment you stop smoking, your body starts healing. Breathr shows you that healing happening — in real time.

Breathr is a science-based quit-smoking companion built around one idea: you don't quit through willpower alone, you quit by seeing proof of progress every single day.

【 SEE YOUR BODY HEAL 】
A live recovery timeline based on WHO and CDC research shows exactly what's improving right now — heart rate in 20 minutes, oxygen levels in 12 hours, taste and smell in 48 hours, lung function in weeks. Your lungs are healing while you read this.

【 BEAT CRAVINGS IN UNDER 3 MINUTES 】
A craving lasts 3–5 minutes, whether or not you act on it. SOS mode gets you through it: box breathing, a 30-second physiological sigh reset, guided urge surfing, and a distraction toolkit. Every craving you survive is logged as a win — because it is one.

【 WATCH YOUR LUNGS RECOVER, MEASURED BY YOU 】
A weekly breath-hold test, done right on your phone, charts your own lung recovery over the weeks — no wearable required. It's your body proving the app is working, not just a promise.

【 A REASON TO OPEN IT EVERY DAY 】
Complete your three daily check-ins and open a reward chest — bonus XP, a science fact, or a shard toward your next Streak Shield. Small, honest reasons to come back, not guilt trips.

【 SLIP UP? START AGAIN, STRONGER 】
Streak Shields absorb a bad day so one slip doesn't erase your progress. If you do restart, your longest streak and lifetime smoke-free days stay banked forever — because a second attempt with real data behind it succeeds more often than the first.

【 WATCH THE MONEY STACK UP 】
Every cigarette you don't smoke is money back in your pocket. Set a savings goal — a trip, a gadget, anything — and watch your smoke-free days pay for it.

【 BECOME A NEW IDENTITY 】
Progress from Smoker → Quitter → Fighter → Warrior → Free. Earn XP for every craving beaten, mission completed, and lesson read. Unlock achievements from your first smoke-free day to your first year.

【 UNDERSTAND YOUR PATTERNS 】
30-second daily mood check-ins and craving logs reveal what actually triggers you — stress, coffee, social moments — and which tools work best for you specifically, so the app gets smarter the more you use it.

【 LEARN AS YOU GO 】
A 90-day course of 2-minute daily lessons on nicotine science, habit loops, and relapse prevention. Optional NRT (patch/gum) tracker with a step-down schedule you control.

【 PRIVATE BY DESIGN 】
No account. No sign-up. Your quit journey stays on your device. We don't sell data — there's nothing to sell.

WHY BREATHR WORKS
• Built on the Transtheoretical Model of behavior change and Fagerström dependence assessment
• Recovery milestones sourced from WHO and CDC research
• Craving tools drawn from CBT and ACT (acceptance and commitment therapy)
• Compassion-first: slips are survivable, streaks are protectable
• Designed for the hardest moments, not just the good days

Breathr Pro unlocks the full experience with a free trial, including the complete recovery timeline, insights, lessons, and unlimited history. Payment is charged to your Apple ID account. Subscriptions auto-renew unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the period, and can be managed in your App Store account settings.

Count your smoke-free days, log a cigarette in one tap, and see what the habit was costing you in the currency you actually pay in.

results.description:
Smoking is hard to stop and easy to explain away. Cigless keeps the two things that actually help in front of you: an honest count of where you are, and something to do about the next ten minutes.

CIGARETTES, AND NOTHING ELSE
Cigless never asks what you smoke, because it is built for cigarettes alone. Your pack price and pack size are what the savings are worked out from, so the money is the money you would have handed over rather than a national average. There is no unit you have to translate your habit into.

BUILT ON WHAT THE RESEARCH SAYS WORKS
- Setup scores the Heaviness of Smoking Index, two questions used in the literature for decades: how many you smoke and how soon after waking the first one happens. It is named on screen, and it is presented as screening rather than a verdict.
- Stop on a date, or step down to one. A Cochrane review finds the two equally effective, so the app recommends one, supports both, and makes a taper end on a real day rather than trailing off.
- A slip is a day you logged, not a failure. Research on lapses is consistent that the shame after one is what turns it into a return to smoking, so your total smoke-free days and your best streak are never taken away from you.
- Craving SOS sits one tap from the main screen and is never behind a paywall: a delay timer, paced breathing, and the reasons you wrote down read back to you. Delay is first because a craving peaks and then goes.
- Reminders follow the shape of withdrawal, with support concentrated in the first three days when it is worst and easing off as you do.
- Every milestone on the recovery timeline links to the institution it came from, including the NHS, the World Health Organization and the National Cancer Institute. No source, no claim.
- Quitting aids work better alongside an app than either does alone, so the guide to nicotine replacement is free, explains what the options are for, and sends the choice to your pharmacist.

FREE, FOREVER
One-tap logging. A smoke-free day counter, the money kept and the cigarettes not smoked. A calendar you can correct for any day, today included. Craving SOS. A morning pledge and an evening check-in. The nicotine replacement guide. Destroy the lot whenever you decide.

CIGLESS PRO
Reminders shaped around your quit date and your score. The sourced recovery timeline. More craving tools, including urge surfing and further breathing patterns. A taper whose daily limit walks down to the day you picked. Your check-ins, read back in context.

NO ACCOUNT, NO SIGN-UP
No email address, no password, no name. Your history is filed under an anonymous ID, so nobody has to be trusted with who you are.

SUBSCRIPTION
Cigless Pro is an auto-renewing subscription. Annual is billed once a year and opens with a 7-day free trial. Monthly is billed once a month. Lifetime is a one-time purchase and never renews. Prices are shown in the App Store for your region.

Unless you cancel it more than 24 hours before the period is up, an auto-renewing plan renews and your Apple Account is charged. Cancelling is done from your App Store account settings, and removing the app from your phone does not do it for you.

Privacy Policy: https://cigless.mriy.io/privacy-policy.html
Terms of Use: https://cigless.mriy.io/terms-of-use.html

Cigless gives general information and habit support. It is not medical advice and it does not replace a doctor. Whether nicotine replacement therapy suits you, and which kind, is a question for a pharmacist or a doctor who knows the rest of your health.

results.description:
Cold turkey not an option?

Smoke Revoke offers a flexible, all-encompassing way to stop smoking at your own pace. Using the natural and effective power of weaning, it builds a smooth quitting plan custom fit to your habit, with a length of your choosing. Quit in a week or across several months.

Schedule your day and stay on track with the Smoke Ring: a 24-hour visual representation of your day. Touch n' Drag editing allows you to set your smoke and sleep times to ensure the app accurately reflects your life for optimal weaning.

The countdown lets you know when it's time to smoke. Day by day as you follow the schedule, cigarettes will begin to slide away. All the while, you'll be gradually and naturally learning the skill set and gaining the awareness you need to really, truly quit. For good!

Ongoing stats show your progress over time, and what lies ahead. Accurately track how much money you've saved, see your total unsmoked cigarettes climb, and more.

Smoke Revoke is try-before-you-buy: a one-week free trial is included.


• Easy setup
A simple 4-step process and you'll be off to the smoking cessation races.

• Weighted program generation
Dropping a cigarette at 20 per day is not the same challenge as at 3 per day, and Smoke Revoke calculates accordingly.

• Interval-based weaning
As you progress, the average amount of time between smokes increases and fewer cigarettes are able to fit into your day.

• Dynamic cigarette total
However long your day is, cigarettes will be added or subtracted to maintain your current average interval.

• Countdown
When you have a craving, pull up the app and see if it's time to smoke yet. Stay on track, learn postponement gradually, and you'll be as good as gold!

• Awareness building
Knowing is half the battle, as they say. Seeing your habit right there in visual 24-hour form goes a long way.

• As active as you want
Turn on Autospace to let Smoke Revoke distribute your smoke times evenly, or get in there yourself and customize your day to your heart's content.

• Adjustable at any time
If you feel the weaning is moving too fast or slow, a quick trip to the program settings can get that in order.

• Stats
Total money saved, days in a row you've stuck with it, comparisons to see how far you've come, and yes, more!

In this guide, we will help you take the first steps to quit smoking. 

Here are the things that will take you to the next level:

- Why Is Smoking So Addictive? 
You should blame nicotine, the primary component of tobacco, for your smoking cigarettes dependency. Your mind quickly adapts to it and immediately demands more to really feel the way you used to feel after smoking just one cigarette.

- The Advantages of Stopping Cigarette Smoking 
Everyone notices you really feel much better when you quit cigarette smoking. Yet did you understand that the health and wellness benefits kick in almost immediately and collect with time? Below’s a wrap-up of what occurs to your body when you quit (Data resource:  US Surgeon General’s Office )

- What Should I Do First?
The hardest days of quitting smoking will be the first few. Decide on a date to stop smoking cigarettes, and then stick to it. Prior to your stop day, write down your justifications for giving up. After stopping, go back and read the list every day.

- Create a Strategy
As you probably already know, there are numerous ways to give up smoking. Some are much more effective than others. The ideal strategy is the one you can follow through with. Identify which of these can be useful to you:
* Cold turkey (no outdoors assistance)
* Behavior modification
* Pure nicotine substitute therapy
* Prescriptions
* Hypnotherapy
* Acupuncture
* Laser treatment
* Combination therapies

- How Will I Really Feel After starting this?
You will undoubtedly experience withdrawal when you stop smoking, both physically and mentally. You might feel the urge to smoke, be irritable and hungry, cough frequently, experience annoyance, or have trouble focusing. Because your body is utilizing only pure nicotine, you are experiencing severe withdrawal symptoms.

- How Tough Will It Be to Stop?
Everyone is different, as well as how difficult it will certainly be for you depends upon: 
•	How many cigarettes do you smoke a day
•	If your loved ones’ participate in smoking
•	Why do you smoke

- How Can I Prevent Smoking Cigarettes Again?
Slipping up frequently is an element of giving up. Even “just one puff” matters to many people who are trying to stop smoking. Additionally, it becomes much more difficult to quit smoking completely if you “have only one.” Sliding, however, does not advocate that you start smoking again. Use your fault to focus on your triggers and learn how to handle food cravings more effectively

- What Happens if I Begin Cigarette Smoking Again?
It’s called regression, and also a lot of people undergo it before they kick the habit forever. It’s also really typical in strong addictions like smoking. If it takes place, try to smoke just feasible up until you’re ready to stop again. Stopping permanently is a process that may take a while. However, it’s worth it.

Take Control of Your Smoking. Quit with Strategy.

Become the master of your cigarette habits—not a slave to cravings.

Quitting smoking isn’t just about willpower. The biggest challenge is overcoming psychological cravings. This app is designed to help you break free from mental dependence and build lasting control over your habits.

Through daily check-ins, interactive simulations, and engaging visual feedback, you’ll gradually weaken cravings, stay on track, and significantly reduce the risk of relapse.

What Is Psychological Craving?

Psychological craving—also known as mental dependence—is the strong urge to smoke driven by emotions, habits, and environment, rather than physical need for nicotine.

It often appears in situations like stress, anxiety, boredom, or social settings—even when your body doesn’t actually need nicotine.

Key Features of Psychological Craving

• Habit Triggers
Smoking is deeply tied to routines—like coffee breaks, driving, or socializing.

• Emotional Dependence
Many smokers rely on cigarettes to cope with stress, anxiety, or low mood.

• Social Influence
Being around other smokers can reinforce the urge to smoke.

• Ritual Behavior
The act of lighting and holding a cigarette can itself become a comforting habit.

Why This App Works

Psychological dependence is often harder to overcome than physical addiction. That’s why this app focuses on behavior, mindset, and habit change—not just nicotine withdrawal.

You’ll build awareness, break patterns, and regain control—step by step.

That’s where QuitNow PRO comes in.

QuitNow PRO was born in 2011, created by a smoker who wanted to quit. Since then, we’ve grown, brought in addiction specialists, and refined our tools so you can quit tobacco for good:

YOUR EX-SMOKER STATUS
When you quit smoking, it’s important to clearly see what you’re achieving. That’s why on QuitNow PRO’s home screen you’ll see how long it’s been since you last smoked, how many cigarettes you haven’t smoked, how much money you’ve saved, and how much life you’ve regained.

LIVE SESSIONS WITH AN EXPERT
Every month we host a live session with a smoking-cessation expert. In these sessions, the psychologist explains the best way to quit smoking and answers attendees’ questions live. These sessions are a unique opportunity to get personalized advice and resolve doubts in real time.

A COMPLETE COURSE TO QUIT SMOKING

MILESTONES: SMALL MOTIVATIONS TO QUIT SMOKING

BOOKS TO HELP YOU QUIT SMOKING

ALSO ON YOUR WATCH

results.description:
No Smoke is the smart, science-backed quit smoking app that helps you track your journey, beat cravings, improve your lung health, and save money — one smoke-free day at a time.
Whether you're stopping completely, cutting down gradually, or just starting to think about quitting — No Smoke meets you exactly where you are. No guilt. No judgment. Just progress.

LUNG HEALTH SCORE
Watch your lungs heal in real time. Your personal lung health score updates as you log smoke-free days, showing exactly how much your body is recovering.

MONEY SPENT & SAVED
Every cigarette you skip puts money back in your pocket. Track exactly how much you've spent on cigarettes and how much you're saving — in your own currency.

SAVINGS GOALS
Turn your cigarette money into something you actually want — a new phone, a vacation, anything. Set a goal and watch your smoke-free days fund it automatically.

SMOKE-FREE STREAK + STREAK SHIELD
Build your streak day by day. And if you slip, our unique Streak Shield system lets you protect your streak by completing healthy activities — so you never feel like starting over.

CRAVING SOS
When a craving hits, open Craving SOS instantly. Use the built-in pursed lip breathing exercise to slow your breath and calm your body, start a 5-minute delay timer, or read a quick CBT-based tip. Cravings peak at 3–5 minutes — you can outlast it.

STATS & TRIGGER TRACKING
Track cigarettes per day, money spent per week, and discover your top smoking triggers — stress, boredom, social, coffee and more. The more you know, the easier it gets.

BODY RECOVERY MILESTONES
From 20 minutes to 10 years — see the scientifically proven timeline of what happens to your body after you quit. Check off milestones as you reach them.

BREATHING FOR CRAVINGS
Built-in pursed lip breathing slows your breathing rate, calms your nervous system, and reduces craving intensity in minutes.

No Smoke is perfect for:
- Smokers ready to quit for good
- People cutting down gradually
- Anyone who has tried quitting before and wants a fresh start
- Smokers motivated by health recovery and real money savings


Questions or feedback?
We read and reply to every message personally — reach us at contact@havabee.com

Still vaping even though you know you should stop? End Vaping Now uses your own voice to break cravings — no willpower, no patches. Just your voice, your identity.

HOW IT WORKS

You record a personal mantra in your own voice — a statement that defines who you want to be. When a craving hits, you open the app and listen. Your voice plays back, interrupting the automatic impulse before it takes over. Your own voice is 3x more effective at rewiring neural pathways than external content.

A craving lasts three to five minutes. ARNAS was made for exactly those minutes.

WHEN A CRAVING HITS
• One tap from any screen, from the widget or right from the app icon
• 5 breathing patterns with haptics, from a simple 4–6 rhythm to 4–7–8
• 30 practical techniques and 40 facts about the habit
• One tap to call the person you chose in advance
• Afterwards ARNAS asks what helped and remembers what works for you

YOUR FIRST 30 DAYS, DAY BY DAY
Two minutes each morning: what is changing in your body right now, why today may be hard, and one small thing worth doing. No lectures, no guilt. Every day has its own illustration.

WATCH YOUR BODY RECOVER
32 recovery milestones, from a normal pulse after 20 minutes to a year smoke-free. A counter of smoke-free days, money saved, cigarettes not smoked and life regained. The widget keeps it on your Home Screen and Lock Screen.

PREPARE FOR HARD DAYS
11 ready plans for the days you can see coming: a party with alcohol, stress at work, a flight, an argument, a night shift, a deadline, a vacation, friends who smoke. Prepare in advance, get tips on the day, look back afterwards.

A RECAP EVERY WEEK
How many cravings you rode out, when and why they hit hardest, and a plan for next week.

IF YOU SLIP
A slip isn't the end. The counter starts over honestly, but everything you've done and learned stays with you, and the course picks up where you left off.

MORE TO KEEP YOU GOING
15 levels, a skill tree with 27 nodes, 24 quests you can't fail, 8 themes, a streak with shields, and letters to your future self, delivered in 30 days, six months or a year.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no server, no ads, no analytics. Your reasons, journal and letters never leave your phone.

MADE BY SOMEONE WHO QUIT
The author smoked for almost twenty years and quit so many times he lost count. What helped wasn't a day counter but simple answers: what is happening in my body right now, and why today is so hard. That is what ARNAS is made of.

ARNAS Pro is available as a monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscription, or as a one-time purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. A subscription renews automatically unless it is cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period; the renewal is charged within 24 hours before the period ends. You can manage or cancel subscriptions in your App Store account settings. Any unused part of a free trial is forfeited when you purchase a subscription.

Smoke Timer helps you gradually reduce cigarette consumption and quit smoking naturally.

How it works:
Set an initial interval between smoke breaks. Each time you press "Smoke", the interval automatically increases by 1 minute.

By increasing the interval by 1 minute, you'll reduce consumption by dozens of cigarettes per day in just a few days. When you reach one cigarette per day, you'll simply forget to smoke at some point.

Quitting smoking becomes smoother - without stress, without sudden restrictions, naturally.

Smoke less. Step by step.
Want to quit smoking, but not ready to stop overnight?
Habitime helps you understand and gradually reduce your smoking without pressure or guilt. Track every cigarette, create more time between smoking sessions, set daily goals, and see how your habits change over time.
TRACK YOUR SMOKING
Log every cigarette in one tap and keep a clear smoking diary.
See:
- Cigarettes per day
- Time between cigarettes
- Daily and weekly progress
- Monthly smoking history
- Smoking triggers
- Money saved
- Daily goal performance
Forgot to log a cigarette? You can add missed entries for today or the previous seven days.
SMOKE LESS AT YOUR OWN PACE
Choose the approach that works for you.
Gradually Reduce
Habitime adjusts your daily target after consistent progress, helping you reduce smoking step by step.
Fixed Daily Target
Set your own cigarette limit and keep it unchanged until you decide to adjust it.
Whether you want to cut down smoking or eventually quit smoking completely, you stay in control of the pace.
CREATE MORE TIME BETWEEN CIGARETTES
Habitime turns your daily target into a personal smoking interval.
A simple countdown timer shows how much time remains until your next planned interval, helping you create more space between cigarettes and make each decision more conscious.
It is not a reminder to smoke.
As your daily target decreases, the time between cigarettes gradually becomes longer.
UNDERSTAND WHY YOU SMOKE
When you log a cigarette, you can also record what triggered it:
- Habit
- Stress
- Coffee
- Social situations
- Boredom
- Other
Over time, your smoking tracker becomes more than a cigarette counter. It helps you notice patterns that can be difficult to see day to day.
Optional reflection questions can also help you become more aware of when and why you smoke.
PROGRESS WITHOUT GUILT
Habitime does not treat a difficult day as failure.
Every cigarette you track gives you useful information. If you stay within your goal, you can continue reducing. If you go over it, you simply keep tracking and continue from there.
No failure screens.

results.description:
STOP Smoking Alarm helps you smoke less without judgement, at a pace you choose.

Most people who want to stop are told to quit on a date and feel like a failure by the weekend. STOP works differently. It shows you what you actually do, then helps you stretch the time between cigarettes, one gap at a time.

CHOOSE HOW TO BEGIN

Tracker. Log each cigarette as it happens. No countdown, no daily maximum, no pressure. Today and Progress show you when you smoke, how often, and what it is costing you. Most people are surprised by their own numbers.

Time Between. Every cigarette you log starts a fresh countdown to your chosen interval. There is still no daily maximum. The aim is simply to make each gap a little longer than the last.

You can switch between the two at any time, and switching never deletes your history.

HELP THE MOMENT A CRAVING HITS

Help Me Wait is always one tap away:

- A guided one-minute breathing reset, with a real recorded voice and an on-screen rhythm to follow
- Guided meditation of 3, 5, 10 or 15 minutes with calming music, saved inside the app so it works offline
- A timed walk with spoken start and finish cues over your own music
- Water, a reminder of your own reasons, or one small distraction

Afterwards it asks how the craving feels, so over time you learn which of these actually works for you.

SEE THE PROGRESS YOU ARE ACTUALLY MAKING

- Today, week, month, year and all-time views
- Your average gap between cigarettes, and how it is changing
- Honest savings based on your own pack price
- Your first day is marked as a part day, so a short first bar is never mistaken for a good one

BUILT ON ONE PROMISE

Your progress is based only on the cigarettes you log. Nothing is ever assumed, estimated, or counted against you.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

No account. No server. No adverts. No analytics. Everything you record stays on your iPhone, and you can erase all of it in two taps. Apple Health is optional and read-only, used solely to show your step count beside a walk.

ALSO INCLUDED

- A countdown on the Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
- Log a cigarette with Siri, without opening the app
- An optional first-cigarette alarm, to push your first of the day a little later each week
- A gentle check-in if your log has been quiet

STOP Smoking Alarm provides behavioural support. It is not a medical device and is not a substitute for professional healthcare. If you are ready for clinical help, your doctor or a local stop-smoking service can offer options this app cannot.

TERMS & PRIVACY

STOP Premium is available as monthly or annual auto-renewable subscriptions, or a one-time lifetime purchase. Payment is charged to your Apple Account. Subscriptions renew automatically unless cancelled at least 24 hours before the end of the current period, and can be managed in your Apple Account settings.
